title: Shatter
wikitext:
[[Monster]]s who are killed by [[hit]]s while [[frozen]] '''shatter''', leaving no [[corpse]] behind. Unique bosses cannot shatter. The on-death effects of many monsters will not occur if they are shattered, such as that of the [[Porcupine Goliath]].

==Mechanics==
{{main|Freeze#Shatter}}

Non-unique enemies that are killed while frozen shatter into pieces. They will still leave loot, but most other on-death effects are prevented, including:
* Leaving a [[corpse]]. This prevents raising or exploding the corpse. Furthermore, there is no corpse to transfer status ailments with {{il|Elemental Proliferation}}.
* Taking on a secondary form, such as the [[Shield crab (monster type)|Shield Crab]].
* Spines shot by the [[Porcupine Goliath]].

These on-death effects are not suppressed:
* Spawning enemies, such as with Fracturing enemies.
* On-death explosions, such as those from a Tormented Martyr.
* Zombies spreading tar.

Kills from damage over time will not shatter enemies. Only hits can cause shatter.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3284453</ref> Culling strike is recommended for damage over time builds that are able to freeze enemies to be able to shatter enemies.

==Skill Gems==
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where = (skill.description LIKE "%shatter%" OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%shatter%")
  AND items.name NOT LIKE "Earthshatter%" 
  AND items.name NOT LIKE "Shattering Steel%"
  AND items.name NOT LIKE "Spectral Shield Throw%"
}}

== Items ==
===Unique Items===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
 item_stats.id LIKE "%shatter%"
 AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%shield_shatter%"
 AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%shattering_steel%"
 AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%earthshatter%"
 AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%boneshatter%"
|level=1
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

===Modifiers===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where = 
 mod_stats.id LIKE "%shatter%"
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%shattering_steel%"
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%earthshatter%"
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%boneshatter%"
 AND domain NOT IN ("9")
 AND generation_type NOT IN ("31")

|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}
====Crafted====
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID
|q_where=
 mod_stats.id LIKE "%shatter%"
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%shattering_steel%"
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%earthshatter%"
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%boneshatter%"
 AND domain = 9
AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%JunMasterCritica%" 
AND mods.id != "JunMaster2CriticalMultiplierOnShatter1"

|stat_text=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}

|generation_type=1

}}

Legacy crafted mods
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID
|q_where= (

|q_where=

}}
